purpose: Provide one explicit current Learning authority manifest that resolves the live Learning selector, control, work obligation, frozen forensic baseline, definitive 113-requirement traceability matrix, ownership, evidence boundaries and dependency-valid successor sequence without creating a competing System Master authority or rewriting historical evidence.

learning_control.standing: ACTIVE / INCOMPLETE / 113-ROW TRACEABILITY CLOSED / 63-HANDLER PRODUCTION BINDING ACTIVE

current_learning_ownership.ownership_rule: Learning owns Learning/Curriculum product semantics. Shared runtime, evidence, research, documents, media, connected actions, programming, spreadsheet/data, Book and other peer semantics remain owned by their current peers and are consumed through explicit interfaces rather than absorbed.

forensic_authority.matrix_control_snapshot_note: Matrix 002 records LEARNING-CONTROL-RECORD-v5.md because that was the control at forensic adjudication. Current lane control is v7; the matrix control field is historical provenance and does not override this manifest or CURRENT-AUTHORITY-005.

definitive_traceability_authority.rule: Traceability closure means every frozen requirement has one explicit current-owner/component/port/persistence/test/evidence/gap/disposition trace. It does not mean every requirement is implemented or production-qualified.

evidence_rules: A green aggregate suite does not close a requirement row unless exact row-level current evidence supports that row.
REBIND-002 34/34 is owner-extraction/architecture evidence and must not be treated as one-for-one closure of the 34 Learning/Curriculum frozen requirement obligations.
The definitive 113-row matrix closes the traceability obligation, not implementation or production completion.
Historical PASS remains exact-subject scoped and does not transfer across changed SHA, handler, persistence path, interface, ownership, topology, native target or production path.
Historical branches and archives are provenance only unless explicitly selected by current authority.
Frozen source rows are append-only evidence inputs; current-authority fields are added through current trace/disposition artifacts rather than rewriting frozen evidence.

current_required_output.rule: A 63/63 disposition denominator may include blocked handlers. Denominator closure must never be interpreted as 63/63 executable PASS unless exact current evidence supports that claim.

dependency_valid_successor_sequence: Bind Learning/Curriculum mutations to the atomic production persistence/unit-of-work/outbox path and rerun relevant regression/recovery evidence.
Bind required current peer authorities and fixtures without duplicate semantic ownership.
Keep model-backed evaluator, independent SME, psychometric, real-learner and other human/external gates independent and evidence-gated.

known_metadata_reconciliation.rule: Do not mutate or version-bump Topology 007 solely to rewrite this historical pointer. If enforcement later requires literal equality, perform a narrowly scoped explicit metadata reconciliation under separate authority.

startup_sequence: Read governance/CURRENT-AUTHORITY.json and confirm CURRENT-AUTHORITY-005 remains selected.
Read this manifest as the canonical Learning startup entrypoint.
Re-fetch learning/control-v1 live head and compare it with learning_control.live_head_sha; classify any mismatch as AUTHORITY_DELTA rather than silently accepting it.
Read LEARNING-CONTROL-RECORD-v7.md from the selected Learning control ref.
Read WORK-OBLIGATION-REGISTRY-016 and select only the current Learning ACTIVE obligation.
Use the definitive 113-row matrix for current requirement traceability and Matrix 002/frozen September 11 evidence for forensic provenance; do not reopen historical branches as current truth.
Preserve Foundation 1.0 Closure as the product-wide central objective and remain inside the Learning mutation lane.
